name: Retry and Backoff
description: Failed tasks retry with exponential backoff. Different failure classes have different retry policies.
purpose: Handle transient failures gracefully while avoiding retry storms through differentiated, backoff-based retry policies.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed tasks are retried with configurable exponential backoff
Different failure classes (transient, resource, permanent) have distinct retry policies
Maximum retry count is bounded and configurable
Backoff includes jitter to prevent thundering herd
Retry state is tracked and observable across the lifecycle
Permanent failures skip retry and go directly to the failure pipeline
